rows.producer: Successful PresentStart in the matching Native SDK Present scope, and actual asynchronous slSetTagForFrame registration
rows.consumer: NGX FG Evaluate -> RunNativePreFg -> fg_service::Record -> required colors, SDK input restoration and MFG cache
rows.success: Synchronous claims require a successful PresentStart in the same SDK scope and verified resource handoff. Eligible synchronous and asynchronous base frames refresh, reuse, and refresh across the required roles with stable same-frame MFG consumption.
rows.refusal: Reject synchronous claims without a successful PresentStart in the matching scope. Reject conflicting tags, missing roles, stale ordering or late SDK failure and recover on a valid frame.
rows.fallback: Use legal per-frame Pre-FG or the original SDK inputs. Publish only complete color groups.

rows.producer: Successful D3D12 SR, selected workset and same-output Native/XeFG Off write permission independent of output FPS
rows.consumer: Borrowed SR recording, matching submission, full refresh/reuse GPU cycles and independent adaptive FPS decisions
rows.success: Compatible fixed worksets keep reusing. A missing FPS window pauses adjustment while the authorized tier keeps delivering. Actual ordered delivery confirms the active cadence.
rows.refusal: Late loss of write permission keeps the successful SR output. A discarded or unproved submission cannot confirm an edited delivery or tier.
rows.fallback: Keep valid fixed x2 or use legal per-frame adaptive NR. A skipped model resumes locally, and unrelated histories follow their actual work.

rows.consumer: Adaptive effective strategy and preparation policy -> actual Feature capacity, worksets and retirement
rows.success: Explicit 0 preserves ordinary preparation. Mode 1 retains a compatible model, mode 2 prepares upper-capacity work, and mode 3 prepares a cold target on demand.
rows.refusal: Bad values, incompatible Create contracts, budget refusal, stale completions and live references cannot misreport a successful strategy.
rows.fallback: Keep configured legal tiers and ordinary preparation per group. Preserve v0.6.0 slot read/write.

rows.producer: Committed NR configuration, successful SDK declarations and each actual swapchain/BB identify the output owner. ReconcileNrService runs after configuration/SDK locks are released.
rows.consumer: Ordinary Present and XeFG revalidate the same color at their final owned submission. Each pool closes its own replay and retains pending SDK/GPU operands.
rows.success: The first legal scene/menu version is delivered once. Optional no-ID frames stay with an enabled SDK; an explicit Off permits ordinary delivery. Independent outputs and guide-only retirements keep their valid work.
rows.refusal: Replayable writes to the same BB, unknown first Execute proofs and Provider dependencies retain their protection. Closing private replay never releases in-flight operands or settles a newer SDK call.
rows.fallback: Pending delivery settles against the original owner. New source/guides reset their own history; the next legal frame resumes after a genuine conflict ends.
